_published_faq.name: How do I add Shutterstock to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Shutterstock to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.shutterstock.com/cciq/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Shutterstock MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Shutterstock scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Shutterstock?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Shutterstock in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Shutterstock does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Shutterstock failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shutterstock scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
